_comment: Seed for the Site Tracker module. Source: Google Sheet 'Site Drawing Updates' > tab 'Stage 7 - Construction Execution'. 19 sections, 177 steps. 'Deep Cleaning' is a section with no sub-steps in the sheet, so it gets one synthetic step (7.18.1). Step codes are the sheet's own codes and are NOT contiguous (the sheet skips some numbers on purpose). Do not renumber.
